en_title: PlayStation Secures Marketing Agreement for The Witcher 4
opus_summary: CDPR在最新财报中确认与PlayStation签订《巫师4》营销协议。双方合作还将涵盖CDPR游戏在PlayStation及PlayStation Plus订阅服务上的内容，可能意味着《巫师3》或《赛博朋克2077》等作品未来会加入订阅服务。《巫师4》目前计划于2028年推出。

paragraphs.en: CD Projekt Red has signed a marketing deal with PlayStation for The Witcher 4 .
paragraphs.cn: CDPR已与PlayStation签订《巫师4》营销协议。

paragraphs.en: The studio confirmed the deal in its latest earnings report, which may also suggest that marketing is about to ramp up. Additionally, CD Projekt Red noted that this partnership will "cover the presence" of its games on PlayStation and PlayStation Plus, which likely means older titles like The Witcher 3 or Cyberpunk 2077 may make their way to the subscription service in the future.
paragraphs.cn: 该工作室在最新财报中确认了这项协议，这或许也意味着营销活动即将加强。此外，CDPR指出，此次合作将「涵盖」旗下游戏在PlayStation和PlayStation Plus上的推出，这可能意味着《巫师3》或《赛博朋克2077》等较早推出的作品未来可能会登陆该订阅服务。

paragraphs.en: “Just today, we signed new partnership agreements with Sony Interactive Entertainment covering the presence of our games on PlayStation and in PlayStation Plus subscriptions, as well as our collaboration during the upcoming Witcher 4 marketing campaign,” said Piotr Nielubowicz, chief financial officer at CDPR. "This cooperation will support our business and financial outlook in this and future years.”
paragraphs.cn: CDPR首席财务官Piotr Nielubowicz表示：「就在今天，我们与索尼互动娱乐签署了新的合作协议，涵盖我们游戏在PlayStation和PlayStation Plus订阅服务上的推出，以及我们在即将开展的《巫师4》营销活动中的合作。这项合作将为我们今年及未来数年的业务和财务前景提供支持。」

paragraphs.en: It wouldn't be surprising if PlayStation uses this agreement to make The Witcher 3 available through PlayStation Plus when the game's new expansion releases in 2027. This deal may also mean that The Witcher 4 has a big presence in a future State of Play stream, though no hard specifics were revealed by CD Projekt Red. Currently, the game is due out in 2028 , so new trailers and gameplay seem likely next year.
paragraphs.cn: 如果PlayStation利用这项协议，在《巫师3》的新资料片于2027年推出时，让该游戏加入PlayStation Plus，也不会令人意外。这项协议也可能意味着《巫师4》将在未来的一场State of Play直播中占据重要位置，不过CDPR没有透露任何确切细节。目前，该游戏计划于2028年推出，因此明年似乎有望看到新预告片和实机演示。

paragraphs.en: The decision also signals an end of an era, to a degree. CD Projekt Red has had a strong relationship with Xbox since The Witcher 3. The game was prominently featured during Xbox's E3 showcases, and that continued with Cyberpunk 2077, even resulting in a special edition Xbox One X console themed after the game. Given PlayStation has a larger user base than Xbox this generation, it makes sense why CDPR may be interested in working with them.
paragraphs.cn: 这一决定在某种程度上也标志着一个时代的结束。自《巫师3》以来，CDPR与XBOX一直保持着紧密关系。该游戏在XBOX的E3发布会上占据了重要位置，这种情况在《赛博朋克2077》时期得以延续，甚至还推出了一款以该游戏为主题的XBOX One X特别版主机。鉴于本世代PlayStation的用户群体比XBOX更大，CDPR可能有意与其合作也就不难理解。

paragraphs.en: Marketing deals can be extremely effective when done right. In the case of GTA 6, a lot of people bought PlayStation 5s instead of an Xbox, since Rockstar and Sony marketed the console as the "best place to play" the game. This led to the game being the biggest launch in PlayStation's history , with 39 million people playing it on PS5. 70% of people who bought a new PS5 during the last week also booted up GTA 6 as their first game.
paragraphs.cn: 营销协议如果运用得当，效果可能极为显著。以《GTA 6》为例，许多人购买了PlayStation 5而非XBOX，因为Rockstar和索尼将这款主机宣传为游玩该游戏的「最佳平台」。这使该游戏成为PlayStation历史上首发规模最大的游戏，有3900万人在PS5上游玩。上周购买新PS5的用户中，也有70%将《GTA 6》作为启动的第一款游戏。
